description: This file defines the ServiceRuntimeWrapper class which wraps the functionality of Microsoft.WindowsAzure.ServiceRuntime.dll using reflection, providing an interface for interacting with Azure role environment details such as deployment ID, role name, endpoints, and lifecycle events. It also defines the IServiceRuntimeWrapper interface for abstraction.

classes.name: IServiceRuntimeWrapper
classes.description: Interface providing methods to access Azure role environment details and lifecycle notifications.

classes.name: ServiceRuntimeWrapper
classes.description: Class that wraps Azure ServiceRuntime functionality via reflection, providing deployment info, endpoints, configuration, and event subscription management.

methods.name: ServiceRuntimeWrapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the wrapper and setting up reflection-based access.

methods.name: GetIPEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves the IP endpoint by name, with error handling.

methods.name: GetConfigurationSettingValue
methods.description: Returns configuration setting value for a given key.

methods.name: SubscribeForStoppingNotification
methods.description: Subscribes a handler to the role instance stopping event.

methods.name: UnsubscribeFromStoppingNotification
methods.description: Unsubscribes a handler from the role instance stopping event.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Loads the assembly and sets up reflection to access Azure role environment details.

methods.name: ExtractInstanceName
methods.description: Static helper to extract the instance name from the instance ID.

methods.name: LogErrorUnableToObtainEndpointInfo
methods.description: Logs an error when endpoint info cannot be obtained.

methods.name: LogWarningAzureServiceRuntimeNotLoaded
methods.description: Logs a warning if the Azure Service Runtime assembly is not loaded.

methods.name: LogErrorAzureServiceRuntimeFailedToLoad
methods.description: Logs an error if the assembly fails to load.
